scope: All four changed tracked files, audit, text-size evidence, representative tasks and local links. Read-only independent source review.

scenarios.unchanged_loop_inputs_tooling_edits: Affected host checks only; no automatic full-slot readback.
scenarios.byte_identical_already_verified_install: Reuse unless explicit reinstall or device-state verification.
scenarios.actual_mismatch: Report and investigate with relevant checks.
scenarios.docs_only: Content and link review; no firmware build.

limits: No builds, runtime tests, device operations or rollout performed by reviewer. Receiver owns safe rollout.
